capabilities: Indent and outdent list items and their subtrees with Tab, Shift+Tab and Alt+arrows
Renumber lists and headings automatically as items move or levels change
Convert pasted bullets and foreign numbers into its own numbering via smart placement
Copy or save lists as plain text, rich text (HTML/RTF), or a nested Markdown list
Configure number formats per level, per note frontmatter, or via saved presets
extras: README documents known limitations, compatibility notes with Tab-binding plugins like Obsidian Outliner, states no network calls or telemetry, and says releases carry build provenance attestations.
problem: Obsidian has no Word-style multilevel numbering that lives in the note text itself and survives export, git and other editors.
summary: Plain-text hierarchical list numbering (1. / 1.1. / a)) driven by Tab, Enter and Alt-arrows, with heading numbering and list conversion.
